title.narrative: Denmark’s Contribution to JRR Association - Justice Rapid Response in 2023-2024

description.narrative: JRR is a Geneva-based organisation created with the aim of providing rapid deployment of criminal justice and related professionals from a stand-by roster, in order to assist and build capacity in developing countries to provide accountability for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity and to ensure that international justice plays an integral role in post-conflict peace building. Operational since October 2009, JRR’s roster recruitment process, which includes a training program, developed and carried out in collaboration with the Institute for International Criminal Investigations (IICI), certifies experts to the JRR roster in order to make them available to build capacity and support criminal justice investigations in developing countries. In 2023, JRR’s Roster has over 750 experts. The roster is gender-balanced, geographically and linguistically diverse, and includes investigators, sexual and gender-based violence experts, forensic experts, prosecutors, military analysts, financial investigators, open-source investigators, psychosocial experts, legal analysts, and child experts. The project is an earmarked contribution to Justice Rapid Response to build capacity in developing countries in support for criminal justice investigations in the years 2023 and 2024.

The project aims to strengthen the capacity in the developing countries to document and legally follow up on the human rights violations and fight against impunity, thus contributing to the stabilization efforts and restoration of the rule of law.
